title: Deficiency Balance Accounts Restart Down Payment Worksheet
content:
**Calculation.** The restart down payment on a Deficiency Balance Account is the band's restart down payment percentage of the balance on the day it is figured, rounded half up to the cent. The restart down payment percentage is 10.0% in every Deficiency Resolution Band (Band 1 through Band 6).

**Order of the figures.** The percentage points that schedules take off are added together and subtracted from the band's restart down payment percentage before that percent is applied; the balance is multiplied by the resulting percent and divided by 100, that product is rounded half up to the cent, and only then is any amount a schedule adds put on top of the rounded figure.

**The latest broken arrangement.** The latest broken arrangement of an account is its arrangement offer with the status broken whose broken date is the latest; an account has only one arrangement in force at a time, so no two of its arrangements break on the same day.

## Worksheet lines

1. Balance on the day the restart down payment is figured.
2. Percent: the band's restart down payment percentage, less the total percentage points taken off.
3. Balance multiplied by the percent, divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent.
4. Any amount added, put on top of the rounded figure of line 3.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Balance | Percent applied | Product | Rounded half up | Restart down payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $2,000.00 | 10.0% | $200.000 | $200.00 | $200.00 |
| $1,000.05 | 10.0% | $100.005 | $100.01 | $100.01 |

A hypothetical illustration of the order: a balance of $1,000.05, a total of 1.5 points taken off and $40.00 added. The percent is 8.5%; $1,000.05 multiplied by 8.5 and divided by 100 is $85.00425, rounded half up to $85.00; the $40.00 is then put on top, giving $125.00.
